title: Memory and code search
lede: Agents waste most of their effort rediscovering things: where a behaviour lives in the code, why a decision was made, what went wrong last week. I gave every agent in my estate the same memory, served by FAFOHive. These eight tools are how an agent asks it questions. Code is indexed by syntax tree, so a search returns whole functions and types with file and line. The code graph answers structural questions without a model. Decisions and fixes are kept as observations, so the reasoning behind a change outlives the session that made it. list indexes lists the code and reference collections that exist and how much each holds. Its names are the scope every search uses.
evidence: Memory for AI agents: 8 tools let an agent search code by syntax tree, search reference material, recall past decisions and fixes, and record new observations.
Code intelligence for AI agents: code-graph tools answer callers, callees and dependency questions without a model, returning file paths and lines.
author: Corey James
